effects.lua_implementation: Standard Synchro procedure and revive limit.

effects.printed_clause: If Synchro Summoned: target an "Altergeist" in GY and Special Summon it in Defense; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed summon trigger checks Synchro type, targets a legal Necrovalley-filtered Altergeist, and revives in face-up Defense under id HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: When opponent activates a monster effect: Tribute an "Altergeist"; negate it, then add a GY Trap that lists "Altergeist"; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_CHAINING checks opponent monster and disablable chain, releases an Altergeist, requires a metadata-listed Trap in GY at activation, negates the effect, then returns one after a break; separate HOPT key.

official_references.matched_structure: Altergeist release cost and chain negation.

coverage_override.reason: The Synchro material line is one procedure unit. The revival trigger and the Tribute/negate/Trap-recovery Quick Effect are the two activated units, each including its HOPT.
